function.name: get_learner_state
function.description: Read the learner's current skill, current item and the mastery estimate of the current skill. Read-only. Returns {success, learner_id, current_skill, current_item, p_mastery, mastered}.

function.name: get_next_item
function.description: Ask the scheduler for the next practice item of the current skill and make it the current item. The answer key is not returned. Returns {success, item_id, skill_id, prompt}.

function.name: record_attempt
function.description: Submit the learner's answer to the current item. The answer is graded deterministically and the BKT mastery policy updates the mastery of the item's skill. Returns {success, item_id, skill_id, correct, p_mastery, mastered}.

answer.description: The learner's answer, copied verbatim from the learner's message.

function.name: give_hint
function.description: Get a hint for the current item without revealing its answer. Returns {success, item_id, hint}.

function.name: reveal_answer
function.description: Get the answer and worked solution of the current item to show to the learner. Returns {success, item_id, answer, worked_solution}.

function.name: set_mastered
function.description: Write mastered = true for a skill in the learner model. The server records the caller of this tool as the writer, whatever actor is claimed. Returns {success, skill_id, mastered}.

skill_id.description: The skill to mark as mastered, e.g. 'frac_add'.

actor.description: Who claims to perform the write, e.g. 'mastery_policy'.

function.name: advance_skill
function.description: Move the learner from the current skill to the next skill in the curriculum (frac_add -> frac_mul -> frac_div). The current item is cleared. Returns {success, previous_skill, current_skill}.

function.name: end_session
function.description: Close the tutoring session and store a short summary. Returns {success}.

summary.description: A short summary of the session.
